children.text: Recorded on January 22, 2011, by David Nevell for the International Dialects of English Archive (IDEA),

features a Cuban-born woman who spent her early childhood in Havana before moving with her family through New York to Puerto Rico. In the unscripted portion of the recording, she recalls her family's first rented apartment in Santurce and reflects on her continuing identification as Cuban. Although originally collected for linguistic research, the recording also provides a situated autobiographical account of migration, settlement, and cultural belonging. It offers an individual perspective rather than a representative account of the Cuban community in Puerto Rico.
